data.name: Alizey
data.gender_notes: Alizey is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Alizey is derived from 'Ali' meaning exalted, noble, and the suffix '-zey' which is a diminutive form. It signifies nobility and elevated status. The name Alizey carries the meaning “Noble, Exalted, Noble Born” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Alizey usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, exalted, noble born and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name is associated with the virtues of Ali ibn Abi Talib, a cousin and son-in-law of the Prophet Muhammad, known for his bravery, justice, and devotion.
data.etymology: Alizey belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble, Exalted, Noble Born.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alizey total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: عليزي
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من علي وزي يعني العلو والرفعة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عليزي مشتق من الجذرين العربيين (ع ل و) و (ز ي) و يعني العلو والرفعة والسمو، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة آيات مثل 'وَلَا تَقْفُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ ۚ إِنَّ السَّمْعَ وَالْبَصَرَ وَالْفُؤَادَ كُلُّ أُولَٰئِكَ كَانَ عَنْهُ مَسْئُولًا' (الإسراء: 36) حيث يشير إلى الرفعة والعلو في المعرفة والفهم.

in_urdu.name: علیزی
in_urdu.meaning: علي اور زي کا مرکب نام، معنی عالی شان، بلند مرتبت
in_urdu.long_meaning: علیزی نام عربی زبان کے دو اجزاء 'علي' اور 'زي' سے ملا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے عالی شان، بلند مرتبت اور سرفراز۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں خاصی اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ علو و رفعت اور تقویٰ کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अलीज़ी
in_hindi.meaning: अली और ज़ी का मिश्रित नाम, अर्थ उच्च स्थान, उच्च पद
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलीज़ी नाम की उत्पत्ति العربية मूल से हुई है, जिसमें 'अली' और 'ज़ी' के शब्दों का मेल है, जिसका अर्थ उच्च स्थान और उच्च पद होता है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत मायने रखता है और इसे पवित्रता और उच्च आत्मा के प्रतीक के रूप में देखा जाता है।

in_english.name: Alizey
in_english.meaning: Derived from 'Ali' and 'zey', signifying nobility and elevation
in_english.long_meaning: The name Alizey originates from the Arabic roots 'Al' (ع ل) and 'Zay' (ز ي), implying nobility, elevation, and sublimity. It reflects a sense of high status and spiritual distinction. Although not directly mentioned in the Quran, the components are derived from terms used in various Quranic verses to denote exaltation and knowledge. The name holds significant cultural and spiritual value across Muslim communities globally.

data.cultural_impact: The name Alizey has its roots deeply embedded in the Islamic culture. Naming a child is considered an honor, and giving them a significant name creates a powerful impact. In various Muslim societies, the name 'Ali' is associated with the Prophet Muhammad's cousin and son-in-law, Ali ibn Abi Talib. As a celebrated figure in Islam, Ali's virtues and qualities such as honor, generosity, bravery, wisdom, and justice continue to inspire Muslims worldwide. The name Alizey highlights these influential personality traits, extending an important cultural connection to Islam's revered history.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the concept of elevated status or nobility holds deep spiritual significance. In the Holy Qur'an, Surah Al-An'am, verse 62 notes that ‘it is not the countenance [or the wealth] they have on their account that delights Allah. But Allah is delights with those who believe and do good works.’ Therefore, having a name like Alizey, which summarizes the qualities of a noble and virtuous individual, can serve as a reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and guide them towards the path of righteousness. Through its spiritual meaning, the name Alizey offers guidance and inspiration for personal growth and self-betterment.
